fy.title: RIT Admissions - First-Year Undergraduate Application (deadlines, checklist, test-optional)

eng.title: RIT Admissions - Undergraduate International Student FAQs (English requirements, scholarships)

test_policy.notes: RIT is test-optional for all undergraduate programs; SAT/ACT is superscored if submitted. STEM applicants submitting ACT are advised to include the optional ACT Science section. International applicants are encouraged to submit SAT/ACT for scholarship review.

requirements.notes: Apply via the Common App or the free-standing RIT Application. A single essay is required; no supplemental essays unless applying to the Honors Program or Individualized Study BS. Minimum 1 recommendation letter (school counselor preferred, teacher letters welcome; up to 3-5 considered). Art/design/film programs require a portfolio. Fee waivers for hardship and military. Interview requirement not found on pages checked. The site does not state the year for each deadline column; the page also advertises Fall 2027 for Early Decision 1 / Early Action, so the dates are treated as the fall 2027 entry cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-December (no exact date); $500 deposit due Jan 15.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Decision late January (no exact date); reply by May 1.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-January (no exact date); $500 deposit due Feb 15.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-March (no exact date); reply by May 1. Later applications are reviewed on a space-available basis.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for applicants from a listed set of English-speaking countries (e.g. USA, UK, Canada except Quebec, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Singapore, Nigeria, Kenya), based on citizenship and/or 2+ years of study there. Scores can be self-reported at application; official scores required on enrollment. Scores below the direct-admission minimum lead to conditional admission with required English-language instruction.

english.notes: Minimum for direct admission consideration (old 0-120 scale, taken before 2026-01-21); 78 or lower = conditional admission.

aid.notes: International first-year applicants are considered for merit scholarships at admission (SAT/ACT encouraged); full-tuition scholarships are not available. RIT need-based grants are awarded from FAFSA results (CSS Profile not used), and the need-based page describes extra need-based aid only for Canadian students. I-20 requires documented support of at least $78,000 USD.
